nodes.label: RULINGS-R4d.md
nodes.author: M
nodes.rationale: Successor to RULINGS-R4c.md, governing where they differ; given on findings R4-04, R4-05 and R4-06.

nodes.label: Workshop Matter
nodes.author: M
nodes.rationale: M: a statement about the book's own quality process is workshop matter and is useless to a reader, so it is struck rather than repaired; a true version would be no more use than the false one.

nodes.label: Part I's 'indexed and closed at E = 0' clause
nodes.rationale: Struck at two sites; no index over the principles need be built, and the measurement E(protocols) = 105 over 19 cells of 24 stays in the record rather than a volume.

nodes.label: §2.21's 'twenty-two audits, no collision'
nodes.rationale: Struck on the same ground: it is false (SCOPE and CENSUS share a cell) and a true version would still be workshop matter. Nothing replaces it; the ruling reaches only the two sentences it names.

nodes.label: Whether the audits index is workshop matter
nodes.rationale: Left explicitly undecided: E(audits) = 16 at §18.5/§18.6, §3.7's dimension certificate and §3.8's growth table are measurements of the quality process but are also what Chapter 32 and P18 rest on.

nodes.label: Search the sources exhaustively before deriving
nodes.author: M
nodes.rationale: M: the resolution likely exists in the Löwdin chats or papers; only if it is held nowhere is it derived, and then from the sound solution rather than invented.

nodes.label: Chapter 34's 'why' — the a reset and the f opening
nodes.rationale: Two separate questions: why a resets where it does (four subshells carry ten resets while filling, finding R4-06) and why L = −∞ at every f opening when p = 0 is false at 5f.
